body:
Parent: #22 (Evidence & Data Trust).

## Traceability and dependencies
Requirements: FR-05, FR-06 (defined in parent epic breakdown).
Depends on: #35, #36, #37

## Outcome
A recipient can inspect provenance and conflicts in an exported report without access to the original live pages or exporting machine.

## Scope and technical plan
- Define a versioned lossless JSON evidence bundle and documented load/reconstruction contract, including product/variant field states, captured evidence, alternatives, resolutions and score semantics.
- Preserve provenance through JSON export/import and SQLite persistence round trips.
- Keep existing CSV/marketplace feeds compatible. Where formats cannot carry nested evidence, provide an explicit opt-in companion bundle/sidecar with stable record mapping; document portability and unsupported/expired evidence handling rather than silently promising losslessness.
- Extend matching/report output to reference retrievable field evidence where available, preserving existing APIs and meanings.

## Acceptance scenarios
- Given a conflicting product with variants and unsupported fields, when JSON-exported and loaded independently, then all evidence references resolve and selected/alternative observations and reasons match.
- Given exported Decimal values and UTC timestamps, then a round trip preserves their semantics and IDs.
- Given a CSV/feed with a companion bundle, then stable record keys locate the corresponding evidence; existing default feed output remains consumable.
- Expired evidence remains explicitly expired in reports, and no model/rule score is relabeled validated confidence.

## Validation and task handoff
Golden semantic round-trip checks, sidecar mapping fixtures and affected JSON/CSV/feed/matching regressions. Document the schema/version and compatibility options.

## Spec Kit workflow
Use one shared feature directory, `specs/002-evidence-data-trust/`. Specify user outcomes and Given/When/Then scenarios in `spec.md`; record architecture, compatibility and resolved questions in `plan.md`; maintain dependency-ordered, requirement-linked work in `tasks.md`. Update the relevant artifacts before implementation and verify spec/plan/tasks consistency before closing this ticket. These are required implementation deliverables, not artifacts already generated by an installed Spec Kit workflow.

## Boundaries and definition of done
Evidence-backed reporting only; no catalog mutations, MCP, webhooks, or other epic work. Preserve MIT licensing and self-hostability. Prefer deterministic, offline fixtures; no model launch or broad live crawl is required. Document public APIs and limitations, and run meaningful affected compatibility checks. Do not equate extraction quality, rule/model scores, and validated confidence.
title: [Epic 2] Preserve evidence and resolutions in portable exports
